market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond yield spike at 20-year highs is pressuring equities (Dow -300, Nasdaq -1%). Oil volatility from Iran adds noise. Trade truce extension provides minor relief but lacks substance. Expect continued yield-driven equity de-rating over 1-3 months unless Fed signals pause. Gold may find support if rate-hike bets prove excessive.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact and resilient to higher rates. Sovereign AI ($600B) and consumer AI adoption create multi-year revenue streams. Biotech innovation pipeline strong. However, concentration risk and yield trajectory cap upside. 6-12 month: expect rotation from mega-cap AI into infrastructure, defense, and emerging markets as rates stabilize.
